content: Hey love, I was looking at our old messages and couldn't stop smiling. You really light up my days, even out here in the middle of nowhere.
Aww, that's so sweet. I think about you all the time too. It's been so nice having someone to talk to again.
You have no idea how much your support means to me. It's rare to find someone who understands what it's like to be so far from home, working hard for a better future.
You work so hard. I admire that. I wish I could do more to help you cope with being away.
Honestly, just knowing you're there for me helps so much. I feel like I can trust you with anything. And when I'm back, I want to show you how grateful I am.
You're really special to me. I can't wait for you to come home. I feel like we're meant to meet in person soon.

I know, darling. I look forward to that moment every day. Actually, I've been trying to arrange my leave, but there's a complication with the company payroll out here. They're asking for a processing fee before they can finalize my request.
Oh no, that's so frustrating. What do you have to do?

It's just a temporary setback. The fee is $2,500, and they only accept payment through Bitcoin because of the remote setup. My bank accounts are inaccessible until I'm back onshore, which is so unfair.
That's a lot of money. Are you sure there's no other way?

I completely understand your concern. I promise you'll get it back the day I land, plus interest, if you want. The company is strict with procedures, but you've always been there for me. I trust you, and I know you trust me.
I do trust you, but I've never used Bitcoin before. How would I even send it?

It's easier than it sounds, love. I can guide you step by step. All you need is to set up a Coinbase account and buy Bitcoin using your debit card. Once you have it, I'll give you the wallet address to send the payment.
Okay... I guess I can try. I just don't want to mess anything up.
Don't worry, you're doing amazing. I'm right here with you. I'll walk you through every part, and I appreciate you so much for helping me out. You're my angel.
Alright, I'm signing up for Coinbase now. Do you have the wallet address ready?
Yes, here it is: 1Jm6d3bXfGH2LmN7w8Vf9RK8cZTxuEwqPq. Just let me know when you've bought the Bitcoin and I'll help with the next step. I can't thank you enough for doing this.
Okay, I'll try to buy the Bitcoin now. I hope this works.
You're so brave for helping me. Don't worry, this is the only thing keeping us apart. Soon I'll be able to hold you for real.
I just bought the Bitcoin. Do I just send it to that address?
Yes, that's perfect. Copy and paste the address carefully, and send the full amount. If you have any questions, I'm right here.
Okay, I'm sending it now. Please let me know when it arrives.
You're incredible. I'll check on my end and update you right away. This means the world to me. Thank you, my love.
